description: This PHP class defines LDAP user data mapping, allowing configuration of LDAP attribute names for user properties and providing methods to get/set these attributes and convert them to an array. It is part of the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin, specific to LDAP user data handling.

classes.name: LDAPUserDataMapping
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that manages the mapping between LDAP attributes and user data fields in OrangeHRM, providing getters, setters, and utility methods.

methods.name: getFirstNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name mapped to the user's first name.

methods.name: setFirstNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the user's first name.

methods.name: getMiddleNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name mapped to the user's middle name, if any.

methods.name: setMiddleNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the user's middle name.

methods.name: getLastNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name mapped to the user's last name.

methods.name: setLastNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the user's last name.

methods.name: getEmployeeIdAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name mapped to the employee ID, if any.

methods.name: setEmployeeIdAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the employee ID.

methods.name: getWorkEmailAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name mapped to the user's work email, if any.

methods.name: setWorkEmailAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the user's work email.

methods.name: getUserStatusAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name mapped to user status, if any.

methods.name: setUserStatusAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for user status.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the LDAPUserDataMapping object's current state into an associative array.

methods.name: setAttributeNames
methods.description: Initializes attribute names from a provided data mapping array.
